about: The ONE source-controlled iOS device evidence table (epic 16774, E4/E7): ANCHOR rows. Per the recorded memory-anchor rule (SceneWorks docs/memory-strategy-contract.md: the anchor + analytic derivation is the complete, self-sufficient admission basis), each anchor family (machine, provider, route, tier, path-free layout digest, mode) carries at most two reviewed device captures at a reference geometry: the fully RESIDENT rung-0 composition (a typed pre-allocation quantum refusal is its evidence) and the fully OPTIMIZED deepest-rung, cheapest-selection composition (completed, >= 3 repeat captures whose spread is the low-end margin). Every other rung, selection and geometry of the family is derived by the anchor law (crate::anchor); another family is not derivable and refuses no_evidence. Rows come only from `scripts/ios/campaign.py capture` then `evidence`, reviewed and committed by a human; capture output never changes admission at runtime. Mac host peaks and launch headroom are never rows.
